Dozens of gold miners killed in airstrikes on Sudan-Egypt border

At least 72 people were killed and 28 injured in airstrikes on an artisanal gold mining camp in a disputed border area between Sudan and Egypt on Saturday. The Sudan Doctors Network and the Emergency Lawyers organization reported the casualties on Sunday. The Emergency Lawyers accused Egypt's air force of carrying out the attack. Neither Egypt nor Sudan has officially commented on the alleged strikes, and the identity of those responsible remains unclear. The area is known for illegal gold mining.
